too_long: {label}'s context is too long ({detail}). Start over with “New chat” at the top right of the panel, or switch to a model with a longer context at the top of the panel.

tool_rounds: {label} called tools for more than {rounds} rounds in a row and was stopped. Try rephrasing your question.
codex.not_installed_fix: After installing, run codex login in a terminal and sign in with your ChatGPT account
codex.broken: codex can't run or isn't responding
codex.broken_fix: Run codex login status in a terminal to see why
codex.not_logged_in_fix: Run codex login in a terminal and sign in with your ChatGPT account
codex.thread_lost: Codex can't find this conversation's earlier thread ({detail}). The old thread was cleared; sending again starts a new Codex thread that can't see the earlier messages.
codex.login_expired: Codex isn't logged in or the login expired: run codex login in a terminal, then send again. ({detail})
codex.limit: Codex hit its usage limit (your ChatGPT plan's quota). Try again later. ({detail})
codex.bad_model: Codex can't use this model: {detail}. Pick another Codex model at the top of the panel.
gemini.not_installed_fix: After installing, run gemini in a terminal and choose Login with Google once

gemini.login_expired: Gemini isn't logged in or the login expired: run gemini in a terminal to log in again, then send again. ({detail})
gemini.limit: Gemini hit its usage limit. Try again later. ({detail})
gemini.bad_model: Gemini can't use this model: {detail}. Pick another Gemini model at the top of the panel.
